---
format:
  typst:
    papersize: a4
    margin:
      top: 6mm
      bottom: 6mm
      left: 7.5mm
      right: 7.5mm
---

```{=typst}
#set document(title: "Form 2: Historical & Pastoral Room Recording Form", author: "Balala Heritage Project")
#set text(font: ("Helvetica", "Arial"), size: 7.2pt, spacing: 100%)
#set par(leading: 0.28em, justify: false)

// Reusable 7.5mm handwriting ergonomic primitives
#let cb = box(width: 7.2pt, height: 7.2pt, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#222222"), radius: 1pt, baseline: 1pt)

#let write-box(w: 100%) = box(
  width: w,
  height: 7.5mm,
  stroke: (bottom: (paint: rgb("#555555"), thickness: 0.55pt, dash: "dotted"))
)

#let labeled-line(lbl, w: 100%) = box(width: w, height: 7.5mm)[
  #align(bottom)[
    #grid(
      columns: (auto, 1fr),
      gutter: 4pt,
      align: bottom,
      [#text(weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#222222"), size: 7.5pt)[#lbl]],
      [#box(width: 100%, height: 7.5mm, stroke: (bottom: (paint: rgb("#555555"), thickness: 0.55pt, dash: "dotted")))]
    )
  ]
]

#let comment-line() = block(
  width: 100%,
  height: 7.5mm,
  spacing: 0pt,
  stroke: (bottom: (paint: rgb("#555555"), thickness: 0.55pt, dash: "dotted"))
)

#let comments-block(n: 2, label: "Additional Comments / Fabric Notes:") = block(
  width: 100%,
  above: 2pt,
  below: 1pt,
  [
    #text(weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#1b365d"), size: 7.0pt)[#label]
    #for i in range(n) { comment-line() }
  ]
)

#let sec-bar(num, title) = block(
  width: 100%,
  fill: rgb("#1b365d"),
  inset: (x: 4.5pt, y: 1.6pt),
  radius: 1.2pt,
  spacing: 0pt,
  [
    #grid(
      columns: (auto, 1fr),
      gutter: 6pt,
      text(fill: white, weight: "bold", size: 8.2pt)[#num],
      text(fill: white, weight: "bold", size: 8.2pt)[#title]
    )
  ]
)

#let sub-bar(num, title) = block(
  width: 100%,
  fill: rgb("#335c8d"),
  inset: (x: 4.0pt, y: 1.4pt),
  radius: 1.0pt,
  above: 2.5pt,
  below: 1.5pt,
  [
    #grid(
      columns: (auto, 1fr),
      gutter: 5pt,
      text(fill: white, weight: "bold", size: 7.6pt)[#num],
      text(fill: white, weight: "bold", size: 7.6pt)[#title]
    )
  ]
)

#let sub-title(txt) = text(weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#1b365d"), size: 7.2pt)[#txt]
#let field-lbl(txt) = text(weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#222222"), size: 7.2pt)[#txt]
#let note(txt) = text(fill: rgb("#444444"), size: 6.5pt, style: "italic")[#txt]

// Form 2 Banners
#let form2-banner(pg, tot) = [
  #if pg == "1" [
    #block(
      width: 100%,
      stroke: 0.8pt + rgb("#1b365d"),
      fill: rgb("#f4f6f9"),
      inset: (x: 5pt, y: 2.2pt),
      radius: 1.5pt,
      [
        #grid(
          columns: (1fr, auto),
          gutter: 8pt,
          [
            #text(weight: "bold", size: 9.8pt, fill: rgb("#1b365d"))[FORM 2: INTERNAL ROOM RECORDING FORM (ONE FORM PER ROOM)] \
            #text(size: 6.7pt, fill: rgb("#333333"))[
              Interior Envelope, Joinery & Fabric Archaeology | Adapted from Burke, Smith & Morrison (2020) & Miles Lewis (1992)
            ]
          ],
          [
            #align(right + top)[
              #text(weight: "bold", size: 8.5pt, fill: rgb("#1b365d"))[BALALA HERITAGE PROJECT] \
              #text(size: 6.8pt, fill: rgb("#555555"))[FORM 2 — PAGE #pg OF #tot]
            ]
          ]
        )
      ]
    )
    #v(1.2pt)
    #block(
      width: 100%,
      fill: rgb("#e8eef5"),
      stroke: 0.5pt + rgb("#1b365d"),
      inset: (x: 5pt, y: 2.0pt),
      radius: 1.2pt,
      [
        #text(weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#1b365d"), size: 6.8pt)[ID CODING GUIDE:] #text(size: 6.8pt, fill: rgb("#222222"))[Link all records to Master Site Map. #strong[Structure ID:] `STR-01`, `STR-02` | #strong[Room ID] (append letter A–Z sequentially from front entrance): `STR-01-A`, `STR-01-B` | #strong[Object ID] (append 2-digit number per room): `STR-01-A-01`, `STR-01-A-02`.]
      ]
    )
  ] else [
    #block(
      width: 100%,
      stroke: 0.8pt + rgb("#1b365d"),
      fill: rgb("#f4f6f9"),
      inset: (x: 5pt, y: 2.0pt),
      radius: 1.5pt,
      [
        #grid(
          columns: (1fr, auto),
          gutter: 8pt,
          [
            #text(weight: "bold", size: 8.5pt, fill: rgb("#1b365d"))[FORM 2: INTERNAL ROOM RECORDING (JOINERY & NOTES) — PAGE #pg OF #tot] \
            #text(size: 6.7pt, fill: rgb("#333333"))[Structure ID: #box(width: 45pt, height: 5.5mm, stroke: (bottom: (paint: rgb("#555555"), thickness: 0.5pt, dash: "dotted"))) | Room ID: #box(width: 45pt, height: 5.5mm, stroke: (bottom: (paint: rgb("#555555"), thickness: 0.5pt, dash: "dotted"))) | Room Name/Use: #box(width: 90pt, height: 5.5mm, stroke: (bottom: (paint: rgb("#555555"), thickness: 0.5pt, dash: "dotted"))) | Date: #box(width: 40pt, height: 5.5mm, stroke: (bottom: (paint: rgb("#555555"), thickness: 0.5pt, dash: "dotted")))]
          ],
          [
            #align(right + top)[
              #text(weight: "bold", size: 8pt, fill: rgb("#1b365d"))[BALALA HERITAGE PROJECT] \
              #text(size: 6.5pt, fill: rgb("#555555"))[INTERNAL ROOM]
            ]
          ]
        )
      ]
    )
    #v(1.0pt)
    #block(
      width: 100%,
      fill: rgb("#e8eef5"),
      stroke: 0.5pt + rgb("#1b365d"),
      inset: (x: 4.5pt, y: 1.8pt),
      radius: 1.2pt,
      [
        #text(weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#1b365d"), size: 6.8pt)[ID CODING GUIDE:] #text(size: 6.8pt, fill: rgb("#222222"))[#strong[Structure ID:] `STR-01` | #strong[Room ID]: `STR-01-A` | #strong[Object ID]: `STR-01-A-01`.]
      ]
    )
  ]
]

// ==========================================
// PAGE 1: IDENTIFICATION, FLOORS, WALLS, CEILINGS
// ==========================================
#form2-banner("1", "2")
#v(1.5pt)

// SECTION 1: ROOM IDENTIFICATION & CONTEXT
#sec-bar("SECTION 1", "ROOM IDENTIFICATION & ARCHITECTURAL CONTEXT")
#v(1.5pt)

#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 1.3fr, 0.9fr, 1fr),
  row-gutter: 2pt, column-gutter: 6pt,
  labeled-line("Structure ID:"),
  labeled-line("Structure Name:"),
  labeled-line("Room ID (e.g. STR-01-A):"),
  labeled-line("Date (DD/MM/YYYY):")
)

#grid(
  columns: (1.2fr, 1.2fr, 1.6fr),
  row-gutter: 2pt, column-gutter: 6pt,
  labeled-line("Inferred Original Use:"),
  labeled-line("Current / Later Use:"),
  labeled-line("Recorder(s) (Full Names):")
)

#grid(
  columns: (1.1fr, 1.1fr, 1.1fr, 1.2fr),
  row-gutter: 2pt, column-gutter: 6pt,
  labeled-line("GNSS Point / Poly ID:"),
  labeled-line("Floor Plan Sheet No.:"),
  labeled-line("Camera Make & No.:"),
  labeled-line("Photo Frame Nos.:")
)

#v(1.5pt)
#grid(
  columns: (auto, 1fr, auto, 1fr, auto, 1fr, auto, 1.2fr),
  gutter: 4pt,
  align: horizon,
  field-lbl("Internal Dimensions:"),
  labeled-line("Length (m):"),
  text(size: 7pt, fill: rgb("#555555"))[×],
  labeled-line("Width (m):"),
  text(size: 7pt, fill: rgb("#555555"))[×],
  labeled-line("Ceiling Ht (m):"),
  field-lbl("Floor Area:"),
  labeled-line("Area (sq m):")
)

#v(1.0pt)
#comments-block(n: 2, label: "Section 1 Additional Comments / Room Context:")

#v(2.0pt)
// SECTION 2: ENVELOPE, FABRIC & FINISHES
#sec-bar("SECTION 2", "ROOM ENVELOPE, FABRIC & FINISHES (INSPECT ALL SURFACES)")

// 2.1 FLOORS & SUB-FLOOR ACCESS
#sub-bar("2.1", "FLOORS & SUB-FLOOR ACCESS")
#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 1fr),
  gutter: 6pt,
  [
    #field-lbl("Floor Substrate & Covering:") \
    #cb Earth / packed clay #h(4pt) #cb Flagstone / slate #h(4pt) #cb Brick pavers \
    #cb Timber floorboards (butt-boarded [square-edge]) \
    #cb Timber floorboards (tongue-and-groove [T&G]) \
    #cb Split / adzed timber slabs #h(4pt) #cb Poured concrete slab \
    #cb Modern sheet / linoleum / vinyl / carpet #h(4pt) #cb Missing / earth floor \
    #labeled-line("Other Floor Type / Coverings:")
  ],
  [
    #field-lbl("Floorboard Details & Sawing Marks:") \
    #grid(
      columns: (1fr, 1fr),
      gutter: 4pt,
      labeled-line("Board Width (mm):"),
      labeled-line("Thickness (mm):")
    )
    #cb Pit-sawn [diagonal marks] #h(4pt) #cb Circular-sawn [curved arcs] \
    #cb Modern milled / dressed #h(4pt) #cb Hand-adzed / split face \
    #field-lbl("Sub-floor Access & Clearance:") \
    #cb Trapdoor present #h(4pt) #cb Floorboards lifting / missing #h(4pt) #cb Inaccessible \
    #note([*Steel Rule Test:* Insert 150mm thin steel rule through shrinkage gaps to test clearance depth and probe for under-floor artefactual deposits or earlier floor levels.])
  ]
)
#v(1.0pt)
#grid(
  columns: (auto, 1fr),
  gutter: 4pt,
  align: horizon,
  field-lbl("Floor Condition:"),
  [#cb Sound/Intact #h(4pt) #cb Borer/Termite hollowed #h(4pt) #cb Dry rot/decay #h(4pt) #cb Water stained #h(4pt) #cb Sagging joists #h(4pt) #cb Broken/Hazardous]
)
#v(1.0pt)
#comments-block(n: 2, label: "Floor Additional Comments / Under-Floor Probing Notes:")

// 2.2 WALLS & INTERNAL PARTITIONS
#sub-bar("2.2", "WALLS & INTERNAL PARTITIONS")
#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 1fr),
  gutter: 6pt,
  [
    #field-lbl("Wall Structure & Substrate:") \
    #cb Vertical timber slabs (drop-in or pinned) #h(4pt) #cb Horizontal slabs/logs \
    #cb Timber stud frame (bush pole / adzed / sawn) \
    #cb Brick (rendered / unrendered / bagged) #h(4pt) #cb Stone masonry \
    #cb Corrugated iron / ripple iron #h(4pt) #cb Mud brick / pisé / pug \
    #cb Asbestos / fibro sheeting (#text(fill: red, weight: "bold")[WHS Hazard: Do NOT disturb])
  ],
  [
    #field-lbl("Internal Wall Linings & Decorative Finishes:") \
    #cb Bare timber / unlined #h(4pt) #cb Lath & plaster (hair mortar) \
    #cb Timber matchboard / V-joint lining boards (width: #box(width: 30pt, height: 5mm, stroke: (bottom: 0.5pt + rgb("#555555")))) \
    #cb Hessian / scrim canvas backing #h(4pt) #cb Pressed metal / Wunderlich \
    #cb Beaver board / Cane-ite / hardboard #h(4pt) #cb Fibrous plaster \
    #cb Limewash / whitewash #h(4pt) #cb Distemper / multiple paint layers \
    #note([*Linings & Wallpaper:* Inspect damaged corners or peeling linings for wallpaper layering, pasted newspapers (dateable mastheads/text), or stencils.])
  ]
)
#v(1.0pt)
#grid(
  columns: (auto, 1fr),
  gutter: 4pt,
  align: horizon,
  field-lbl("Wall Condition:"),
  [#cb Sound/Intact #h(4pt) #cb Plaster cracked/drummy #h(4pt) #cb Peeling wallpaper/scrim #h(4pt) #cb Termite hollowed #h(4pt) #cb Water ingress/damp #h(4pt) #cb Out of plumb/bowing]
)
#v(1.0pt)
#comments-block(n: 2, label: "Wall Additional Comments / Wallpaper & Newspaper Masthead Notes:")

// 2.3 CEILINGS & OVERHEAD FRAMING
#sub-bar("2.3", "CEILINGS & OVERHEAD FRAMING")
#grid(
  columns: (1.1fr, 1fr),
  gutter: 6pt,
  [
    #field-lbl("Ceiling Form & Construction Material:") \
    #cb Open to rafters / unceiled (underside of roof / battens visible) \
    #cb Lath and plaster ceiling #h(4pt) #cb Timber matchboard / bead-board \
    #cb Pressed metal / Wunderlich panels #h(4pt) #cb Hessian / calico / canvas cloth \
    #cb Beaver board / Cane-ite sheets #h(4pt) #cb Plasterboard / fibrous plaster \
    #cb Corrugated iron sheets #h(4pt) #cb Bagging / hessian bags \
    #labeled-line("Other Ceiling Type / Fasteners:")
  ],
  [
    #field-lbl("Cornice, Rosette & Overhead Details:") \
    #cb Square-stopped (no cornice moulding) \
    #cb Simple timber quad / bead cornice #h(4pt) #cb Moulded timber cornice \
    #cb Cast plaster / run plaster cornice #h(4pt) #cb Pressed metal cornice \
    #cb Ceiling rose / medallion (Cast plaster / Pressed metal / Timber) \
    #cb Manhole / roof void access hatch present (Location: #box(width: 50pt, height: 5mm, stroke: (bottom: 0.5pt + rgb("#555555")))) \
    #cb Ceiling sagged / partially collapsed #h(4pt) #cb Stained / water damaged
  ]
)
#v(1.0pt)
#comments-block(n: 2, label: "Ceiling Additional Comments / Roof Void Access Notes:")

#pagebreak()

// ==========================================
// PAGE 2: JOINERY, SERVICES, SCARS, STRATIGRAPHIC SUMMARY
// ==========================================
#form2-banner("2", "2")
#v(1.5pt)

// 2.4 INTERNAL OPENINGS & JOINERY
#sub-bar("2.4", "INTERNAL OPENINGS & JOINERY (DOORS, WINDOWS, SKIRTINGS)")
#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 1fr),
  gutter: 6pt,
  [
    #field-lbl("Internal Doors & Construction:") \
    #cb Ledge & brace (vertical tongue-and-groove boards with Z-bracing) \
    #cb Framed ledge & brace #h(4pt) #cb 2-panel #h(4pt) #cb 4-panel (raised/beaded) \
    #cb 4-panel (flat/square) #h(4pt) #cb 6-panel #h(4pt) #cb Modern flush / hollow core \
    #cb Door missing / opening only #h(4pt) #cb Sliding barn / timber batten gate \
    #field-lbl("Door Hardware & Fasteners:") \
    #cb Hand-forged thumb latch (Norfolk/Suffolk) #h(4pt) #cb Cast iron rim lock \
    #cb Mortise lock with brass/ceramic knob #h(4pt) #cb Padlock bolt / hasp \
    #cb Cast iron butt hinges #h(4pt) #cb Hand-forged strap/T-hinges on pintles
  ],
  [
    #field-lbl("Windows, Internal Glazing & Reveals:") \
    #cb Double-hung sash (timber cords/weights) #h(4pt) #cb Casement (hinged) \
    #cb Fixed sash / hopper #h(4pt) #cb Pivot sash #h(4pt) #cb Multi-pane (e.g. 6-over-6) \
    #cb Cylinder/crown glass (distorted/wavy) #h(4pt) #cb Modern float glass \
    #cb Internal timber architraves intact #h(4pt) #cb Splayed reveals / timber sill \
    #field-lbl("Skirting Boards & Baseboards:") \
    #cb No skirting / square stop #h(4pt) #cb Plain square dressed board \
    #cb Moulded profile (Ogee / Torus / Scotia) #h(4pt) #cb Replaced / modern \
    #labeled-line("Skirting Height (mm):")
  ]
)
#v(1.0pt)
#comments-block(n: 2, label: "Joinery Additional Comments / Hardware & Tooling Marks:")

// 2.5 HEATING, COOKING & FIXED SERVICES
#sub-bar("2.5", "FIREPLACE, HEATING, COOKING & FIXED SERVICES")
#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 1fr),
  gutter: 6pt,
  [
    #field-lbl("Fireplace, Chimney Breast & Stove:") \
    #cb None in this room #h(4pt) #cb Brick chimney breast #h(4pt) #cb Stone breast \
    #cb Corrugated iron / timber-framed sheeted bush fireplace \
    #cb Open hearth firebox with iron crane/pot-hooks \
    #cb Cast iron register grate (coal/wood grate) \
    #cb Kitchen fuel stove / range (e.g. Metters, Dover, Crown, Esse) \
    #cb Colonial brick baking oven / alcove #h(4pt) #cb Corner fireplace \
    #labeled-line("Mantelpiece (Timber / Marble / Iron / None):")
  ],
  [
    #field-lbl("Fixed Built-in Fittings & Joinery:") \
    #cb Built-in timber cupboards / press #h(4pt) #cb Wall shelving / plate racks \
    #cb Meat safe / perforated zinc mesh cupboard #h(4pt) #cb Corner pantry \
    #cb Pastoral fittings (shearing chute, wool bin, classing table, wool press) \
    #cb Industrial fittings (blacksmith forge, tuyere, anvil block, water trough) \
    #field-lbl("Fixed Services & Utilities:") \
    #cb No services #h(4pt) #cb Surface wiring on porcelain insulators/cleats \
    #cb Early timber capping / conduit #h(4pt) #cb Modern wiring / power points \
    #cb Gas lighting pipe / brackets #h(4pt) #cb Lead / galvanized water supply \
    #cb Sink / wash tub / copper / drain
  ]
)
#v(1.0pt)
#comments-block(n: 2, label: "Heating & Services Additional Comments / Stove Foundry & Model Marks:")

// 2.6 ALTERATIONS, STRUCTURAL SCARS & GRAFFITI
#sub-bar("2.6", "ALTERATIONS, STRUCTURAL SCARS & GRAFFITI (BUILDING ARCHAEOLOGY)")
#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 1fr),
  gutter: 6pt,
  [
    #field-lbl("Structural Scars & Blocked Openings:") \
    #cb Blocked doorway (infill: brick / timber / iron) \
    #cb Blocked window #h(4pt) #cb Doorway cut through earlier partition \
    #cb Removed partition scar (ghost mark on ceiling/floor/wall) \
    #cb Infilled fireplace / removed stove flue hole \
    #cb Ghost marks from removed shelves, staircases, or counters \
    #cb Lowered ceiling / modern false ceiling framework
  ],
  [
    #field-lbl("Diagnostic Marks, Inscriptions & Graffiti:") \
    #cb Carpenter / assembly marks (Roman numerals, chiselled marks) \
    #cb Timber brand / sawmill stencil / shipping mark \
    #cb Manufacturer stamp / paper label / patent date \
    #cb Historic pencil tally marks (wool bales, shearing tallies, livestock) \
    #cb Historic pencil / ink inscriptions or names (Date(s): #box(width: 45pt, height: 5mm, stroke: (bottom: 0.5pt + rgb("#555555")))) \
    #cb Historic / modern scratched graffiti
  ]
)
#v(1.0pt)
#comments-block(n: 2, label: "Alterations & Inscriptions Additional Comments / Exact Transcriptions:")

#v(2.5pt)
// SECTION 3: UNSTRUCTURED ROOM NOTES & STRATIGRAPHIC SUMMARY
#sec-bar("SECTION 3", "UNSTRUCTURED ROOM NOTES & STRATIGRAPHIC SUMMARY (MILES LEWIS ARCHAEOLOGY)")
#v(1.0pt)
#note([*Phasing Synthesis:* Synthesize chronological sequence of this room (original layout vs. additions/modifications). Note relationships between floor, wall, and ceiling joins, blocked doors, re-used timbers, surface wear patterns, paint stratigraphy, and cross-references to object inventory entries.])
#v(1.5pt)
#for i in range(10) { comment-line() }
```
